details:
- CVE-2026-55717: fix a crash in the serve-expired reply path when a response-ip
  or RPZ CNAME redirect is merged
- CVE-2026-56444: decrement the reply address counter when discard-timeout drops
  a reply
- CVE-2026-77860: stop serve-expired replies from decrementing the wait-limit
  counter twice
- CVE-2026-55708: add the default local zones to views that get local data
  through unbound-control
- CVE-2026-54478: build the DNS server cookie from the PROXYv2 client address,
  not the proxy address
- CVE-2026-56416: reject RDATA that ends before its second domain name and keep
  the canonicalization of RDATA names inside the RDATA
- CVE-2026-50248: do not use a BOGUS primary hostname as transfer source in auth
  and RPZ zones
- CVE-2026-50251: add 0.0.0.0/8, ::, ::ffff:0:0/96 and ::ffff:127.0.0.0/104 to
  the addresses do-not-query-localhost excludes
- CVE-2026-50243: return SERVFAIL for BOGUS answers instead of rewriting them in
  response-ip and RPZ
- CVE-2026-109125: drop the pending queries of the port when
  unwanted-reply-threshold flushes the cache
- CVE-2026-35501: ignore a forged NSEC at the apex of an island trust anchor
  below an insecure parent
- CVE-2026-50106: treat a signed NXDOMAIN from an insecure parent above an
  island trust anchor as bogus
- CVE-2026-42923: apply the NSEC3 hash limit to the negative cache DS lookup and
  size its NSEC3 no-data message correctly
- CVE-2026-44608: keep the RPZ lock while the NS IP and NS name triggers are
  applied
- CVE-2026-44687: fix the off-by-one in harden-below-nxdomain that let a parent
  NXDOMAIN shadow a stub or forward zone apex
- CVE-2026-46582: do not mark a replayed wildcard rrset secure from its RRSIG
  alone
- CVE-2026-42955: clamp the TTL of A and AAAA glue in the rrset cache as well as
  NS
- CVE-2026-50046: keep a copy of the DoT authentication name in the waiting_tcp
- CVE-2026-44621: whitelist libworker_alloc_cleanup for libunbound with
  unwanted-reply-threshold
- CVE-2026-50045: count max-global-quota across DNSSEC validation restarts and
  validator sub-queries
- CVE-2026-96405: limit the decompression pointers per received reply and per
  transfer packet
- CVE-2026-77955: do not serve or write a zone to disk while its ZONEMD
  verification is still waiting for DS or DNSKEY
